newsitem.title: UK: Honeysuckle trade suspended, announcement due.
newsitem.headline: Honeysuckle trade suspended, announcement due.

text.p: Honeysuckle Group said on Friday it had temporarily suspended its shares from 0900 GMT, pending an announcement.
The company's shares closed on Thursday at 39.5p, sharply higher than its previous year peak of 22p.
"The directors of Honeysuckle note the recent rise in the price of the company's ordinary shares," the women's fashion company said in a statement.
"They hope to make an announcement later in the day to give further information," it added.
